cases.question: What parking assistance is offered?
cases.text: Rear parking sensors come standard across all variants. A rear camera with dynamic guidelines is standard from EX(O) upwards, excluding E and EX. Front parking sensors and a surround view monitor are standard on SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.

cases.question: Is a panoramic sunroof available?
cases.text: Yes, a smart panoramic sunroof is available starting from the EX(O) trim. Higher trims like SX, SX Premium, King, and King Knight add voice control to the panoramic sunroof. It is not available on the base E and EX trims.

cases.question: What wheel and tyre choices are listed?
cases.text: For road wheels, the E and EX trims come with 205/65 R16 tyres on steel wheels with wheel covers. EX(O) gets that same tyre size with dual-tone styled steel wheels. Separately, spare wheels come in a 205/65 R16 steel size for trims up to SX Premium, and a 215/60 R17 steel size for S(O) Knight, King, and King Knight. There's a part of that I couldn't verify, so I won't guess.

cases.question: Which features would help in a crowded city parking space?
cases.text: For city parking, rear parking sensors come standard across all variants of the Creta. typed_q025_repair.question: Which connected-car features can I use?

sentences.text: On the SX, SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition trims, you get Hyundai Bluelink with over-the-air updates and Home-to-Car connectivity with Alexa, which requires a third-party Echo device purchase.
For the SX trim and above, Hyundai Bluelink provides over 70 connected features along with three years of complimentary service.
Higher trims also pair this Bluelink technology with a Bose premium sound system.
